title: Local vision route: send images to the local model only
goal: A chat turn with an image is answered by the local vision model, never by a cloud route
acceptance: Owner decisions 2026-11-26 in chat: fpvbuddy:F-023 "A" (retire the on-device assistant and the vision demo), with "vision capabilities ideally on nerv too"; Italian is required for every model-facing feature (the owner uses all modules in Italian).
The model adapter passes images to Ollama (/api/chat images field) for a route marked vision-capable in docs/agents/model-profiles.json; any other route refuses an image turn with a typed error

Tests: an image turn goes to the vision route with the image bytes; a cloud or remote route is never called with an image (spy on the provider); no vision model configured gives the Italian or English refusal text from i18n
privacy: Images stay on the owner's machines: no cloud route receives an image; tests use invented images generated in the test (no personal photos, no EXIF from real devices) and no secrets.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one adapter change, a capability flag and provider-spy tests. Not a measurement.
